To help you answer a few questions faster, some short notes on our audit-logging capabilities: 
- Admin activity logs: capture actor (email/id), action type (role change, key creation, config change), resource, timestamp, and source IP. Logs are retained with metadata and are queryable in the console.
- API/request logs: include request_id, model used, prompt and response token counts, latency, and associated route/tenant id. For customers on Dedicated/Private we surface full request/response payloads under strict controls.
- Exports: logs can be exported on demand or via scheduled delivery to customer S3 using encrypted transfer; exports available as compressed JSON/CSV and parquet for analytics.
- Immutability: we use append-only storage for audit logs and provide signed digests for tamper-evidence; for Private deployments customers may enable write-once storage.

A couple of follow-ups for you:
- Can you confirm the export format you prefer (S3 bucket + parquet preferred for analytics)?
- Any required retention period (e.g., 1 year, 7 years)?

Hi Bob / Marissa —

Wanted to add technical detail so you have exact fields and export options for the questionnaire: 

Admin activity logs (sample fields):
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- actor_id / email
- action (e.g., ROLE_UPDATE, API_KEY_CREATE, DEPLOYMENT_SCALE)
- resource_type / resource_id
- source_ip
- request_id (if action via API)
- outcome/status

API/request logs (sample fields):
- timestamp
- request_id
- tenant_id / route
- model_id
- prompt_token_count / response_token_count
- latency_ms
- http_status
- error_code (if any)
- metadata (customer-provided tags)

Export and immutability: 
- Exports: scheduled delivery to customer S3 (server-side encrypted), one-off exports as gzipped ndjson/parquet, or streaming to a customer-managed SIEM.
- Immutability: logs are written to an append-only store with monotonically-increasing sequence numbers; we publish signed merkle-style digests for log ranges to provide tamper-evidence. For Private deployments we support write-once buckets (WORM) and retention lock.
- Retention: configurable at tenant level; common presets: 90 days, 1 year, 7 years. Longer retention can be provisioned for archive.

If helpful, I can generate a sample export (parquet) with redacted example rows and walk through the schema in a 30-minute session. What times work next week?
